_meta.title: Character from reference (Anima Ref Adapter pilot, legacy)
_meta.description: Legacy pilot graph, the fallback of packs/anima/anima_ref.json when the installed ComfyUI-Anima-Ref-Adapter predates the v2 AnimaRefAdapter node (one character only). Anima base v1.0 + ElectronGirl Anima Ref Adapter pilot: one reference image of a character supplies identity, the prompt supplies only quality tags + gender/solo + scene/pose. LoadImage -> AnimaRefLatent (VAE-encodes the reference, letterboxed on white to the target size; also emits the empty latent) -> AnimaRefGuider (cfg 4.5, ref_guidance 4.5, APG correction) -> SamplerCustomAdvanced (euler / simple, 30 steps). Weights: diffusion_models/anima-base-v1.0.safetensors, text_encoders/qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors, vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors (circlestone-labs/Anima), loras/anima_ref_adapter_pilot_r32.safetensors (ElectronGirl/anima-ref-adapter). CircleStone Labs Non-Commercial License. Built by src/lib/oj/animaRef.ts (reference image, prompt, negative, size, seed).
